scope: Jicamarca local hydrologic children: Qda. Colca versus Río Seco

igp_source.title: Aspectos geológicos y geodinámicos de flujos aluvionales en la quebrada Jicamarca y análisis de la vulnerabilidad para la implementación de un Sistema de Alerta Temprana (SAT) en el centro poblado Cajamarquilla
igp_source.bounded_claim: The study describes Colca, El Silencio and Río Seco as distinct tributary components of the Jicamarca system.

quarantined_artifacts.quarantine_reason: Frozen coordinates derive from the ANA 270-hito table labelled Qda. Colca. Existing rio_seco identifiers are legacy semantic binding and must not be interpreted as hydrologic attribution.
Exact source coordinates are preserved for provenance, but the source table label is Qda. Colca and cannot be rebound to Río Seco.

igp_spatial_probe_effect.interpretation: The bounded spatial probe strengthens Qda. Colca source reproducibility but cannot promote it to Río Seco because independent IGP identity evidence keeps the two components distinct.

next_gate: resolve Río Seco natural channel identity from an independent official hydrographic source, DEM/topology workflow or explicit official crosswalk that distinguishes Río Seco from Colca
retain Qda. Colca as a separate local hydrologic component/context if incorporated
do not infer outlet, confluence, travel time, attenuation, discharge or receiver response from the quarantined faja
